# Nikita

> Service that parses 1C:Enterprise event logs (.lgf/.lgp and .lgd) and exports them to ClickHouse, with optional Solr and Redis; runs as a Windows service or a Linux systemd daemon.

Nikita is written in Python (CherryPy, clickhouse-driver). It auto-discovers infobases in 1C server clusters, parses the registration log of each, keeps read positions in SQLite so it resumes after restarts, and sends events in batches to ClickHouse. A built-in web panel shows progress and errors, `/stats_api` returns JSON statistics, and an optional `POST /mcp` endpoint lets AI clients run read-only SQL against ClickHouse. Windows builds use PyInstaller and an NSIS installer. Documentation is in Russian. Licence: GPLv3.
